patterns.label: em dash
patterns.advice: Replace with a full stop, comma, colon or parentheses.

patterns.label: negative contrast setups (not just X but Y / It is not X. It is Y)
patterns.advice: State the positive claim directly and drop the setup clause.

patterns.label: formal connectives (Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally)
patterns.advice: Use 'also', 'but', 'so', or start a new sentence.

patterns.label: summary connectives (In summary/Overall/Ultimately)
patterns.advice: Cut. If the paragraph is a summary the reader can tell.

patterns.label: LLM corporate verbs (delve/leverage/foster/navigate/streamline/spearhead/bolster)
patterns.advice: Replace corporate/academic AI verbs with plain English: use, help, lead, strengthen, guide.

patterns.label: puffery & overused adjectives (robust/pivotal/testament/multifaceted/bespoke/holistic)
patterns.advice: Exaggerated AI praise words and buzzwords. Cut or replace with concrete facts, metrics, or simpler words.

patterns.label: abstract nouns (landscape/realm/tapestry/journey/cornerstone)
patterns.advice: Name the actual thing instead of relying on cliché metaphors.

patterns.label: canned opening (In today's fast-paced world / ever-evolving)
patterns.advice: Cliché opening with zero information. Cut straight to the actual point.

patterns.label: canned email/article opening (I hope this email finds you well / Look no further)
patterns.regex: \b(I hope this (email|message) finds you well|look no further( than)?|without further ado|whether you('re| are) a [^,.;]+ or a)\b
patterns.advice: Dead giveaway of raw ChatGPT output. Delete the filler and state your request or point immediately.

patterns.label: cliché balance & dualism (double-edged sword / delicate balance)
patterns.regex: \b(double-edged sword|delicate balance (must be|between)|only time will tell)\b
patterns.advice: Avoid unhelpful balance clichés. Take a concrete stance or specify the actual operational trade-off.

patterns.label: hedge preamble (It is important to note)
patterns.regex: [Ii]t('s| is| should be) ((important|worth|crucial|vital|essential) (to note|noting|mentioning|remembering|keeping in mind)|(worth noting|worth mentioning|noted that|mentioned that))
patterns.advice: Delete the preamble and state the claim directly.

patterns.label: rule of three in a sentence (A, B and C)
patterns.advice: Check each one: is it a real list, or three items invented for rhythm?

patterns.label: obsolete attachment cliché (Enclosed please find)
patterns.advice: Obsolete bureaucratic cliché. Use 'Attached is...' or 'I enclose...' instead.

patterns.label: bureaucratic throttle (Please be advised that)
patterns.advice: Archaic government boilerplate. Cut preamble and state the fact directly, or use 'Please note that...'.

patterns.label: archaic receipt cliché (in receipt of)
patterns.advice: 19th-century commercialese. Replace with 'Thank you for your letter/document' or 'We received'.

patterns.label: stilted commercialese (as per your request)
patterns.advice: Stilted bureaucratic phrase. Use 'As requested' or 'As you requested' instead.

patterns.label: sincerity tells (genuine/honest) [Claude]
patterns.advice: Claude sincerity cluster (~10x human frequency). Cut or replace with 'real'.

patterns.label: nuanced / non-trivial [Claude]
patterns.advice: Plain-word replacements.

patterns.label: straightforward [Claude]
patterns.advice: Use 'simple' or cut.

patterns.label: let me unpack / key distinction [Claude]
patterns.advice: Cut meta-commentary.

patterns.label: rhetorical questions [Claude]
patterns.advice: Claude asks ~3.9 per 1,000 words. In a report, convert to statements.

patterns.label: because-chaining [ChatGPT]
patterns.advice: ChatGPT hooks clauses with 'because' at ~6.5 per 1,000 words.

patterns.label: simile scaffolding (as if) [ChatGPT]
patterns.advice: Mostly a fiction tell.

patterns.label: power verbs (supercharge/unleash/dive in) [ChatGPT]
patterns.advice: Cut marketing hype verbs entirely.

patterns.label: intensifiers (incredibly/highly/massive/vital) [Gemini]
patterns.advice: Gemini leads on booster words at ~6.1 per 1,000.

patterns.label: uncontracted formality (it is / we must / do not) [Gemini]
patterns.advice: Softens to plain statements.

patterns.label: formulaic transitions (First and foremost / Last but not least) [DeepSeek]
patterns.regex: \b(First and foremost|Last but not least|It is evident that)\b
patterns.advice: DeepSeek/LLM formulaic transitional phrases. Replace with direct statements.

patterns.label: sweeping false range (from X to Y, from A to B) [DeepSeek]
patterns.advice: Double pseudo-range setup. Specific examples are much clearer.
